head.lead: Freelance developer, four ways to work.

head.citable: {identity} I build websites with Next.js, apps with React Native and Expo, and AI integrations. You can hire me by the hour ({hourly}), for fixed-price work (from {feature}), with website and app packs (from {packFrom}) or as part of your staff. Prices exclude VAT.

hourly.text: I reinforce your team or your agency with web, mobile or AI development. An hour costs {price}, excluding VAT.

fixed.text: A feature whose scope, price and deadline are agreed before starting. For something bigger, look at the packs.
fixed.what: Scope, price and deadline are agreed before a line is written. Anything outside the scope is quoted separately, never charged by surprise.

packs.text: A website or an app with a fixed price and deadline. Pick the pack closest to what you need and I will prepare the proposal.
packs.note: Prices are starting prices, excluding VAT. Domain, hosting and store accounts in your name.

compare.caption: Five packs, starting prices, excluding VAT
compare.request: Ask for a proposal with this pack
compare.requestName: Ask for a proposal with this pack: {name} ({code})

P1.includes: Presentation website + contact + base SEO + legal texts. No management or orders.

P2.includes: Everything in P1 + orders or bookings + basic management (add, edit and delete products or appointments). No internal panel.

P3.includes: Everything in P2 + internal panel with roles: orders, customers, stock, schedule, exports, basic invoicing or a connection to one of your tools.

P4.includes: Everything in P3 + automations (alerts, emails, WhatsApp, syncing with tools, reports) + AI (replies, classification, summaries).

P5.includes: iOS and Android app, 3 to 5 screens, user accounts, a simple server and publishing on the stores.

P5plus.name: Extended app
P5plus.includes: Everything in the MVP + notifications, payments or a connection to your system's API.

extras.title: Extras
extras.lead: Added to any pack. Prices exclude VAT.

maintenance_basic.label: Basic maintenance
maintenance_basic.description: Backups, dependency and security updates, and one round of content changes a month. No hosting.

maintenance_extended.label: Extended maintenance
maintenance_extended.description: Everything in basic + priority support (24 working hours), three rounds of changes, a monthly report and 2 hours of development a month that accumulate.

seo_basic.label: Basic SEO
seo_basic.description: Metadata, Google Business, sitemap and speed.

seo_full.label: Full SEO
seo_full.description: Basic SEO + keywords, five optimized pages, internal linking and a report.

geo.label: GEO
geo.description: Optimization for AI search and agents: structured data, llms.txt, citable content and directories.

security_audit.label: Cybersecurity review
security_audit.description: Review of headers, dependencies, forms, permissions and backups; a report with the fixes applied.
